cards.name: Zero Mother of the A.I.P Ex

coverage_override.reason: Xyz materials, Beast-effect immunity, material-derived race change, attach Quick Effect, and unique-control rule are five audit units.

effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and aux.AddXyzProcedure require at least two Level 9 materials and allow additional legal materials.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers a multi-material Level 9 Xyz Summon procedure and revive limit.

effects.printed_clause: Unaffected by the effects of Beast monsters your opponent controls.
effects.lua_implementation: A single EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT accepts Monster Effects whose handler is a Beast, whose effect handler player is the opponent, and whose activation location is the Monster Zone, correctly using control-at-activation rather than card ownership.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a single-range monster-effect immunity predicate based on the source monster/effect relationship.

effects.issue: Fixed: immunity now tests the effect handler's player rather than its owner, so control-changing Beast monsters are evaluated correctly.

effects.printed_clause: Face-up monsters on the field, in the GY, or banishment with an original Type matching an attached material are treated as Beast monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: A field EFFECT_CHANGE_RACE now targets both players' entire LOCATION_ONFIELD plus GY and banishment. Its filter requires Monster Card type, face-up status outside the GY, and an original Race overlap with at least one current overlay material.

official_references.matched_structure: Derives a live monster-class effect from current Xyz materials and applies it through a field effect.

effects.issue: Fixed: face-up Monster Cards in Spell/Trap Zones are now included by LOCATION_ONFIELD.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn during the Main Phase: detach 1 material; attach up to 2 Monster Cards on the field to this card.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main Phase Quick Effect detaches one overlay as cost, gathers legal non-Token Monster Cards in both Monster Zones, lets the controller select one or two, sends their existing overlays to the GY by rule, and overlays the selected cards.

official_references.matched_structure: Detaches Xyz material as cost and attaches selected field monsters as overlay material.

effects.printed_clause: You can only control 1 Zero Mother of the A.I.P Ex.
effects.lua_implementation: SetUniqueOnField(1,0,id) enforces one copy on the controller's field.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses card-level field uniqueness/procedure structure on an Xyz Monster.
